svg.title: Stock OpenMTP 3.3.0’s engine can’t upload to this tablet at all (Lenovo Tab TB311FU, USB 2.0)
svg.desc: 1,000 × 1 MB upload: ReMTP 4.7× faster than the patched engine. ReMTP: 61.6 s, 16.2 MB/s. OpenMTP 3.3.0 engine: fails, timeout, 0 bytes written. go-mtpfs with the ZLP fix (not OpenMTP 3.3.0): 292.1 s (4 min 52 s), 3.4 MB/s. 100 × 30 MB upload (mean of 2 runs): ReMTP 1.2× faster than the patched engine. ReMTP: 75.0 s, 40.0 MB/s. OpenMTP 3.3.0 engine: fails, timeout, 0 bytes written. go-mtpfs with the ZLP fix (not OpenMTP 3.3.0): 90.1 s, 33.3 MB/s. 2 × 1.5 GB upload: ReMTP 1.2× faster than the patched engine. ReMTP: 70.5 s, 42.6 MB/s. OpenMTP 3.3.0 engine: fails, timeout, 0 bytes written. go-mtpfs with the ZLP fix (not OpenMTP 3.3.0): 83.0 s, 36.1 MB/s. 100 × 30 MB download: ReMTP 1.1× faster. ReMTP: 87.1 s, 34.5 MB/s. OpenMTP 3.3.0 engine: 96.7 s, 31.0 MB/s. go-mtpfs with the ZLP fix (not OpenMTP 3.3.0): not measured. 100 × 30 MB upload: mean of the runs (ReMTP 75.3 s, 74.6 s; go-mtpfs with the ZLP fix (not OpenMTP 3.3.0) 89.2 s, 91.0 s). MB/s for a mean is the data size divided by the mean time. The stock engine times out after ~31 s on every upload (LIBUSB_ERROR_TIMEOUT, OpenMTP issue #411). “go-mtpfs with the ZLP fix” is that engine with one bug patched (bench/openmtp-harness/zlpfix.patch); it is not OpenMTP 3.3.0. Method: ReMTP 0.1.0 pre-release (Nov 19 build, before the public history) vs go-mtpx@18f12db + go-mtpfs@1c3302b (the engine inside OpenMTP 3.3.0, run without its UI, with OpenMTP 3.3.0's bundled libusb). iMac 2019 (Intel), macOS 15.8, random data, MB = 10^6 B. Details and raw tables: see docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
